afterhours.name: Afterhours
afterhours.description: Compact neon arena. Short loops, balconies and a diagonal mirror pair.

switchyard.name: Switchyard
switchyard.description: Four warehouse loops, crawl exits, hiding alcoves and two flanking lofts.

glassworks.name: Glassworks
glassworks.description: Large garden courtyards: hedge loops, recessed hiding pockets, elevated overlooks and mirror shortcuts.

mirror-yard.name: Mirror Yard
mirror-yard.description: A layered industrial courtyard. Climb four stair routes to the rooftop loop, crouch through red service tunnels, or escape through paired mirror alcoves.

neon-carnival.name: Neon Carnival
neon-carnival.description: A neon fairground: carousel plaza, arcade rooftops, bumper court and a crouch tunnel.
